title: Beedrill Has Three Stingers, But One Is Worse
premise: Beedrill has three poison barbs, but its tail barb secretes the most powerful poison.
audiencePromise: Follow Beedrill's three stingers to reveal why the tail barb is its most dangerous one.
openLoop: If all three stingers are poisonous, why is the tail barb worse?
payoff: Beedrill can jab repeatedly with all three stingers, but its tail barb carries the most powerful poison.
engagementQuestion: Foreleg stingers or tail barb: which threat scares you most?

voice.instructions: Tense and precise. Start with a sharp warning, build steadily, then land the tail reveal with a quiet, dangerous emphasis.

scenes.headline: THREE STINGERS. ONE IS WORSE.
scenes.narration: Beedrill has three stingers, but one is worst.
scenes.caption: THREE BARBS ENTER. ONE OUTRANKS THEM.

scenes.headline: TWO SIT ON ITS FORELEGS
scenes.narration: Two poisonous stingers sit on Beedrill's forelegs, part of three.
scenes.caption: FORELEG BARB • FORELEG BARB

scenes.headline: ALL THREE CAN JAB
scenes.narration: Those three poisonous stingers can jab an enemy repeatedly.
scenes.caption: JAB • JAB • JAB

scenes.headline: STRIKE, THEN FLY OFF
scenes.narration: Then Beedrill flies at high speed, striking with its stingers.
scenes.caption: BLINK AND IT'S GONE

scenes.headline: THE TAIL HAS STRONGER POISON
scenes.narration: But its tail barb secretes the most powerful poison.
scenes.caption: VENOM METER: MAXED OUT

scenes.headline: FORELEGS OR TAIL?
scenes.narration: Foreleg stingers or tail barb: which threat scares you most?
scenes.caption: TWO JABS OR ONE DEADLIER BARB?
